name: Methi Malai
ingredients: 2 cups fresh fenugreek leaves (methi), washed and finely chopped
1/4 cup cashew paste (soaked and ground cashews)
1 tablespoon dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), crushed
instructions: 1. Blanch the fenugreek leaves in boiling water for 1-2 minutes to reduce bitterness, then drain and set aside. 2. Heat ghee in a pan over medium heat; add cumin seeds and let them splutter. 3. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown (about 5-7 minutes). 4. Stir in ginger-garlic paste and green chilies; cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 5. Add the blanched fenugreek leaves, turmeric, and salt; cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally. 6. Lower the heat, and slowly stir in the cashew paste and cream; simmer gently for 5 minutes, ensuring the cream does not curdle. 7. Sprinkle garam masala and crushed kasuri methi; stir well and cook for another 2 minutes. 8. Remove from heat and serve hot with naan or basmati rice.
description: A velvety, fragrant symphony of bitter fenugreek leaves and creamy cashew-almond richness, tempered with a whisper of warm spice.
